questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ANSI/SPARC में प्रयुक्त तीन स्कीमाओं में से एक नहीं है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following is NOT one of the three schemas used in ANSI/SPARC?
questions.explanation: The ANSI/SPARC three-schema architecture consists of: (1) External Schema – user view, (2) Conceptual Schema – logical view of entire database, (3) Internal Schema – physical storage view. 'Implementation' is NOT a standard schema in this model.

questions.questionText: ट्रांजेक्शन-सर्वर सिस्टम को किस नाम से भी जाना जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Transaction-server systems are also known as?
questions.explanation: Transaction-server systems (also called query server systems) accept SQL queries or transactions from client applications, execute them, and send back results. The clients do not manipulate disk pages directly.

questions.questionText: एक ही ऑपरेशन के साथ समानांतर निष्पादन सर्वरों की संबद्ध संख्या को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The number of parallel execution servers associated with a single operation is called its?
questions.explanation: The 'Degree of Parallelism' (DOP) refers to the number of parallel execution servers (processes/threads) that work simultaneously on a single database operation. Higher DOP = more parallelism = faster execution on multi-CPU systems.

questions.questionText: त्री-स्कीमा मॉडल में प्रयुक्त तीन में से कौन-सा स्कीमा डेटाबेस का पूर्ण तार्किक दृष्टिकोण है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the three schemas in the three-schema model is a complete logical view of the database?
questions.explanation: The Conceptual Schema represents the complete logical view of the entire database. It describes what data is stored and the relationships among the data, hiding physical storage details and showing a unified logical structure.

questions.questionText: त्री-स्कीमा मॉडल में प्रयुक्त तीन में से कौन-सा स्कीमा यह दर्शाता है कि उपयोगकर्ता डेटाबेस को कैसे देखते हैं?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the three schemas used in the three-schema model represents how users view the database?
questions.explanation: The External Schema (also called View Level) represents how individual users or user groups view the database. Different users may have different external schemas (views) showing only the data relevant to them.

questions.questionText: ट्रांजेक्शन-सर्वर सिस्टम एक प्रदान करता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Transaction-server systems provide a?
questions.explanation: Transaction-server systems provide an interface to which clients connect to submit transactions/queries. The server processes these and sends results back. This client-server interface is the defining characteristic.

questions.questionText: संबंधपरक स्कीमा और संबंधों के बारे में अन्य मेटाडेटा को ______ नामक संरचना में संगृहीत किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Relational schemas and other metadata about relations are stored in a structure called the?
questions.explanation: A Data Dictionary (also called System Catalog) stores metadata — descriptions of all tables, columns, data types, constraints, indexes, views, and other database objects. It is the 'database about the database'.

questions.questionText: एक सर्वर प्रक्रिया जो लॉक ग्रांट, लॉक रिलीज और डेडलॉक डिटेक्शन का प्रबंधन करती है, को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: A server process that manages lock grants, lock releases, and deadlock detection is known as?
questions.explanation: The Lock Manager Process is responsible for: (1) Granting locks to transactions, (2) Releasing locks when transactions complete, (3) Detecting deadlocks when two or more transactions wait for each other's locks.

questions.questionText: एकाधिक CPU का प्रभावी ढंग से उपयोग करने के लिए, इसे डिज़ाइन करने की आवश्यकता होती है-
questions.questionTextEn: To effectively use multiple CPUs, it is needed to design?
questions.explanation: To utilize multiple CPUs effectively, database systems must be designed for parallel execution — distributing work across CPUs simultaneously. This includes inter-query parallelism and intra-query parallelism.

questions.questionText: हालाँकि सभी डेटाबेस पेशेवर प्रदर्शन से संबंधित हैं, डेटाबेस पेशेवर का चयन करें जो डेटाबेस प्रदर्शन से संबंधित होने की सबसे अधिक संभावना है?
questions.questionTextEn: Although all database professionals are concerned with performance, which professional is most likely to be concerned with database performance?
questions.explanation: The Database Administrator (DBA) is primarily responsible for database performance tuning, monitoring, optimization, backup/recovery, and security. Performance is a core DBA responsibility.

questions.questionText: कौन-सा डेटा मॉडल डेटा elements के बीच parent-child संबंध बनाता है और प्रत्येक child को केवल एक parent रखने के लिए प्रतिबंधित करता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which data model creates parent-child relationships between data elements and restricts each child to have just ONE parent?
questions.explanation: The Hierarchical Data Model organizes data in a tree-like structure where each child node has EXACTLY ONE parent. This is its defining constraint. Example: IBM's IMS system. Network model allows multiple parents per child.

questions.questionText: क्लाइंट को सर्वर से जोड़ने के लिए ट्रांजेक्शन-प्रोसेसिंग सिस्टम के इंटरफेस को ______ नाम दिया गया है?
questions.questionTextEn: An interface of transaction-processing systems to connect clients with a server is named as?
questions.explanation: A Transactional Remote Procedure Call (Transactional RPC) is the interface used by transaction-processing systems for clients to connect to servers and execute transactions remotely, ensuring ACID properties are maintained.

questions.questionText: डेटा के लिए संचार की इकाई क्या हो सकती है?
questions.questionTextEn: The unit of communication for data (between general-purpose computer systems with only a few processors) can be of?
questions.explanation: Coarse-granularity parallelism involves a small number of powerful processors working on large data units. General-purpose systems with few processors use coarse-granularity parallelism. Fine-granularity uses many small processors on tiny data units.

questions.questionText: कौन-सा डेटा मॉडल डेटा elements के बीच parent-child संबंध बनाता है और प्रत्येक child को एक से अधिक parent रखने में सक्षम बनाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which data model creates parent-child relationships between data elements and enables each child to have MORE THAN ONE parent?
questions.explanation: The Network Data Model extends the hierarchical model by allowing each child node to have MULTIPLE parents, creating a graph (network) structure instead of a tree. Example: CODASYL database systems.

questions.questionText: केवल कुछ ही प्रोसेसर वाले अधिकांश सामान्य-उद्देश्य वाले कंप्यूटर सिस्टम को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Most general-purpose computer systems with only a few processors are said to be of?
questions.explanation: Standard general-purpose computers with a small number of processors (like personal computers or small servers) use Coarse-granularity parallelism where each processor handles large independent chunks of work.

questions.questionText: वह प्रक्रियाएं जो प्रश्नों को निष्पादित करती हैं और परिणाम को वापस भेजती हैं, कहलाती हैं?
questions.questionTextEn: The processes that execute the queries and send the result back are known as?
questions.explanation: Server Processes (also called query server processes) receive SQL queries from clients, execute them against the database, and send results back to the client. Each client connection typically gets its own server process.

questions.questionText: क्लाउड कंप्यूटिंग में सर्वर टाइम, नेटवर्क स्टोरेज और ह्यूमन इंटरक्शन की किसके माध्यम से प्रोविजन किया जा सकता है?
questions.questionTextEn: In Cloud computing, server time, network storage, and human interaction can be provisioned through?
questions.explanation: On-Demand Self-Service is a key cloud computing characteristic where consumers can provision computing capabilities (server time, storage, etc.) automatically without requiring human interaction with service providers.

questions.questionText: पुराना तार्किक डेटाबेस मॉडल जो डेटा को पेड़ जैसी संरचना में व्यवस्थित करता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The older logical database model that organizes data in a tree-like structure is?
questions.explanation: The Hierarchical Database Model is one of the oldest database models (1960s-70s), organizing data in a tree-like parent-child structure. IBM's IMS (Information Management System) is the classic example.

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा डेटा मॉडल टेबल स्ट्रक्चर में डेटा स्टोर करता है और टेबल rows और columns पर विभिन्न ऑपरेशन करता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following data models stores data in table structures and performs various operations on table rows and columns?
questions.explanation: The Relational Data Model stores data in tables (relations) with rows (tuples) and columns (attributes). SQL is used to perform operations on these tables. It was proposed by E.F. Codd in 1970.

questions.questionText: Hierarchical डेटाबेस कब बहुत कुशल होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: When is the Hierarchical database very efficient?
questions.explanation: Hierarchical databases are efficient when: (1) Handling small/simple transaction loads, and (2) Handling large amounts of structured data with clear parent-child relationships (like file systems or organizational charts). They are NOT efficient for complex queries.

questions.questionText: SQL एक ______ है?
questions.questionTextEn: SQL is a?
questions.explanation: SQL (Structured Query Language) is a Non-Procedural (declarative) language — you specify WHAT data you want, not HOW to get it. The database engine decides the execution plan. This contrasts with procedural languages (C, Java) where you specify step-by-step HOW.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस डेटा फाइलें ________ में संगृहीत की जाती हैं?
questions.questionTextEn: The database data files are stored in?
questions.explanation: In database systems (especially Oracle, PostgreSQL), database data files are stored in Tablespaces — logical storage units that map to physical data files on disk. A tablespace can contain multiple data files.

questions.questionText: बैक-एंड पर सर्वर सिस्टम आर्किटेक्चर है?
questions.questionTextEn: The server system architecture at the back-end has?
questions.explanation: The back-end of a database server architecture contains the SQL Engine (query processor, optimizer, execution engine) that processes SQL queries. The front-end has user interfaces, reporting tools, and data mining tools.

questions.questionText: ______ डेटाबेस वितरण की एक विधि को संदर्भित करता है जिसमें एक डेटाबेस में डेटा होता है जो दूसरे डेटाबेस में शामिल होता है।
questions.questionTextEn: ______ refers to a method of database distribution in which one database contains data that are included in another database.
questions.explanation: Database Replication is the process of copying and maintaining database objects in multiple databases to ensure consistency. One database contains data that is also included in another database (replica). Used for fault tolerance and load balancing.

questions.questionText: एकतरफा कंप्यूटिंग क्षमताओं का प्रावधन विशेषता के माध्यम से सेपा जा सकता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Unilateral provision of computing capabilities can be assigned through the characteristic of?
questions.explanation: On-demand self-service allows users to unilaterally (independently, without human interaction with provider) provision computing resources like server time and storage as needed.

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा डेटाबेस एडमिनिस्ट्रेटर के लिए एक प्रमुख क्षेत्र नहीं है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following is NOT a major area for the database administrator?
questions.explanation: Major DBA areas include: Security, Planning, Implementation, Performance tuning, Backup & Recovery. 'Programming' (application coding) is primarily a developer's role, not a DBA's core responsibility.

questions.questionText: DBA का सतलब-
questions.questionTextEn: DBA stands for?
questions.explanation: DBA stands for Database Administrator — the professional responsible for managing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing database systems.

questions.questionText: एक टेबल पर ट्रिगर जो ठीक एक समय बिंदु के लिए विशिष्ट क्रियाओं को सक्षम बनाता है, क्या कहलाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: A trigger on a table that enables specific actions for exactly ONE timing point is called?
questions.explanation: A Simple Trigger fires at exactly ONE timing point (BEFORE or AFTER a single DML event). A Compound trigger can fire at MULTIPLE timing points (BEFORE STATEMENT, BEFORE EACH ROW, AFTER EACH ROW, AFTER STATEMENT).

questions.questionText: एप्लिकेशन का व्यावसायिक तर्क कहता है कि किन परिस्थितियों में किन क्रियाओं को करना है, इसमें अंतर्निहित है-
questions.questionTextEn: The business logic of the application (what actions to carry out under what conditions) is embedded in?
questions.explanation: In three-tier architecture, the Application Server (middle tier) contains the business logic — the rules that determine what operations to perform under what conditions. The client handles UI, the DB server handles data.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस .......... जो डेटाबेस का तार्किक डिज़ाइन है, और डेटाबेस ............... जो किसी दिए गए समय पर डेटाबेस में डेटा का एक स्नैपशॉट है।
questions.questionTextEn: Database ______ is the logical design of the database, and database ______ is a snapshot of the data in the database at a given instant in time.
questions.explanation: Schema = logical design/structure of the database (stable, changes rarely). Instance = the actual data in the database at a specific point in time (changes with every insert/update/delete). Schema is the blueprint; Instance is the current state.

questions.questionText: एक एकल क्लाइंट प्रक्रिया के लिए अनुरोध को संभालने वाली सर्वर प्रक्रिया ______ की जिम्मेदारी है?
questions.questionTextEn: A server process handling requests for a single client process is the responsibility of?
questions.explanation: In a Dedicated Server configuration, each client connection gets its own dedicated server process. This contrasts with shared server configurations where multiple clients share server processes.

questions.questionText: डिस्क स्थान को कम करने के लिए डेटा खंडों के संपीड़न को ............... के रूप में जाना जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The compression of data segments to reduce disk-space is known as?
questions.explanation: Table Compression is a database feature that reduces the disk space used by tables by compressing data segments. It saves storage and can also improve I/O performance by reducing the amount of data read from disk.

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक डेटाबेस की संरचना का वर्णन करने के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली अवधारणाओं के संग्रह का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following refers to a method/collection of concepts used to describe the structure of a database?
questions.explanation: A Data Model is a collection of conceptual tools for describing data, data relationships, data semantics, and consistency constraints. It provides an abstraction for understanding database structure. Examples: Relational model, ER model, Network model.

questions.questionText: Relational मॉडल .............
questions.questionTextEn: The relational model..........?
questions.explanation: ALL three statements about the relational model are correct: (1) It was developed at IBM's San Jose Research Lab. (2) E.F. Codd first proposed it in his landmark 1970 paper 'A Relational Model of Data for Large Shared Data Banks'. (3) E.F. Codd (Edgar F. Codd) developed it.

questions.questionText: भौतिक डेटाबेस डिज़ाइन का निर्णय किस पर पड़ने वाले प्रभावों के कारण सावधानी से किया जाना चाहिए?
questions.questionTextEn: Physical database design decisions must be made carefully because of impacts on?
questions.explanation: Physical database design decisions (indexes, partitioning, storage) impact ALL three: (1) Data accessibility — how easily data can be reached, (2) Response times — query performance speed, (3) Security — physical access controls.

questions.questionText: विभाजन का एक लाभ यह है कि ............?
questions.questionTextEn: An advantage of partitioning is?
questions.explanation: Partitioning ADVANTAGES include: Simplicity of data management (each partition is independent), improved query performance, easier maintenance. DISADVANTAGE is extra space and update time overhead.

questions.questionText: विभाजन का एक नुकसान ______ है?
questions.questionTextEn: A disadvantage of partitioning is?
questions.explanation: Partitioning DISADVANTAGES: (1) Extra storage space needed for partition metadata, (2) Extra update time as partitions must be maintained. Simplicity is the ADVANTAGE, not disadvantage.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस सिस्टम को संरचित कंप्यूटर आर्किटेक्चर का फायदा उठाने के लिए भी डिज़ाइन किया जा सकता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Database systems can also be designed to exploit computer architectures structured?
questions.explanation: Database systems can be designed to exploit parallel computer architectures — using multiple CPUs/processors working simultaneously to improve performance. This is the basis of parallel database systems.

questions.questionText: एक योजना यह निर्धारित करती है कि डेटाबेस में किस भाषा का प्रतिनिधित्व किया जा सकता है?
questions.questionTextEn: A scheme that determines which language can be represented in a database is called its?
questions.explanation: A Character Set (charset) defines which characters can be stored in the database and how they are encoded. Examples: UTF-8 (supports all Unicode characters/languages), ASCII (English only), Latin1. It determines language support.

questions.questionText: Periodic checkpoints को perform करने के लिए जिम्मेदार प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The process responsible for performing periodic checkpoints is called?
questions.explanation: The Checkpoint Process is specifically responsible for performing periodic checkpoints — synchronizing the database buffer cache with data files, writing dirty buffers to disk and recording a checkpoint in the log for recovery purposes.

questions.questionText: जबकि एक DDL ऑपरेशन वस्तु पर कार्य करता है या संदर्भित करता है, यह किसके द्वारा संरक्षित है?
questions.questionTextEn: While a DDL operation acts on or refers to an object, it is protected by?
questions.explanation: When DDL (Data Definition Language) operations (CREATE, ALTER, DROP) are being executed on a database object, that object is protected by a DDL lock (a type of locking mechanism). This prevents other operations from modifying the object simultaneously.

questions.questionText: त्री-टियर आर्किटेक्चर में एप्लिकेशन सर्वर एक्सेस करने के लिए डेटाबेस सिस्टम के साथ संचार करता है-
questions.questionTextEn: The application server in a three-tier architecture communicates with a database system to access?
questions.explanation: In three-tier architecture: Client (UI) ↔ Application Server (business logic) ↔ Database Server. The application server communicates with the database to access DATA — retrieving, inserting, updating, or deleting data as needed by business logic.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस सुरक्षा प्रदान करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
questions.questionTextEn: The database security is responsible for providing?
questions.explanation: Database security encompasses ALL three: (1) Encryption — protecting data in transit and at rest, (2) Authentication — verifying user identity, (3) Access control — determining what authenticated users can do.

questions.questionText: मर्ज संबंध महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि ............?
questions.questionTextEn: Merge relation is important because?
questions.explanation: Merge relations are important in database systems for: (1) New data requirements (integrating new data sources), (2) Replication (merging replicated data), (3) Distribution (merging distributed data from multiple nodes).

questions.questionText: कंप्यूटर डिस्क स्टोरेज में डेटाबेस की व्यवस्थित करना _______ में किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Organizing the database in computer disk storage is done in?
questions.explanation: Physical Database Design involves deciding how the database will be stored on physical storage (disks) — including file organization, index structures, data placement, partitioning strategies, and storage allocation.

questions.questionText: ______ डेटाबेस डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन की एक विधि को संदर्भित करता है जिसमें डेटाबेस के विभिन्न भाग नेटवर्क में विभिन्न नोड्स पर रहते हैं।
questions.questionTextEn: ______ refers to a method of database distribution in which different portions of the database reside at different nodes in the network.
questions.explanation: Horizontal Partitioning (fragmentation) distributes different portions/fragments of the database across different nodes in a network. Unlike replication (same data on multiple nodes), partitioning splits data so each node has DIFFERENT data.

questions.questionText: वह शब्द जो यह बताता है कि किन परिस्थितियों में क्या करना है, क्या कहलाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The term that says what actions to carry out under what conditions is known as the?
questions.explanation: Business Logic defines the rules, conditions, and actions of an application — what should happen (what actions) under specific circumstances (what conditions). It represents the core functionality and rules of a business application.

questions.questionText: डेटा डिक्शनरी कैश के रूप में भी जाना जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Data dictionary cache is also known as?
questions.explanation: The Data Dictionary Cache (in Oracle) is also called the Row Cache because it caches rows from the data dictionary tables. It stores metadata about database objects for quick access by the database engine.

questions.questionText: वह concurrency control, जिसमें एक पृष्ठ या कई पृष्ठों पर एक साथ सभी डेटा को एक साथ लॉक किया जाएगा, की क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The concurrency control in which all data on a page or multiple pages will be locked simultaneously is known as?
questions.explanation: Page Locking (also called page-level locking) locks an entire database page (a fixed-size block of storage, typically 4KB-16KB) at once. All rows on that page are locked simultaneously, regardless of which specific rows need to be accessed.

questions.questionText: डेटा एक्सेस और डेटाबेस गतिविधियों को प्रतिबंधित ________ की जिम्मेदारी है?
questions.questionTextEn: Restricting data access and database activities is the responsibility of?
questions.explanation: Data Access Control is responsible for restricting who can access data and what database operations they can perform. It includes authentication, authorization, and privilege management (GRANT/REVOKE in SQL).

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी बुनियादी डेटा वितरण रणनीतियाँ हैं?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following are basic data distribution strategies?
questions.explanation: The three basic data distribution strategies are: (1) Centralized — all data at one site, (2) Partitioned — data divided across sites, (3) Replication — copies of data at multiple sites. All three are fundamental distribution approaches.

questions.questionText: बफर को लगातार आधार पर डिस्क पर ब्लॉक करने वाली प्रक्रियाओं को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The process that modifies buffer blocks back to disk on a continuous basis is called?
questions.explanation: The Database Writer Process (DBWn in Oracle) continuously writes modified (dirty) buffer blocks from the database buffer cache back to the data files on disk. This is a background process that runs continuously.

questions.questionText: प्रशासनिक स्तर पर समस्याओं की जांच के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले नैदानिक डेटा वाली फाइल कहलाती है?
questions.questionTextEn: A file containing diagnostic data used to investigate problems at the administrative side is called?
questions.explanation: A Trace File contains diagnostic data about database errors, performance issues, and background process activities. DBAs use trace files to investigate and troubleshoot database problems. In Oracle, background processes create trace files automatically when errors occur.

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से किस कमांड का प्रयोग टेबल के अंदर एक कॉलम को मॉडिफाई करने के लिए किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following commands is used to modify a column inside a table?
questions.explanation: ALTER TABLE is the DDL command used to modify the structure of an existing table — adding/dropping/modifying columns. Example: ALTER TABLE emp MODIFY (salary NUMBER(10,2)). UPDATE is DML (modifies DATA, not structure).

questions.questionText: SQL कथन सहित एक तार्किक इकाई को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: A logical entity including a SQL statement is called?
questions.explanation: A Database Operation is a logical entity that includes SQL statements for data manipulation (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE). It represents an action performed on the database using SQL.

questions.questionText: उपयोगकर्ता प्रश्न प्राप्त करने वाली प्रक्रियाओं को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The processes that receive user queries are known as?
questions.explanation: Server Processes receive SQL queries/requests from user processes (clients), parse and execute them, and return results. They act as the interface between client applications and the database engine.

questions.questionText: जब दो या दो से अधिक उपयोगकर्ता एक-दूसरे द्वारा लॉक किए गए डेटा की प्रतीक्षा कर रहे हों, तो ऐसी स्थितियों को जाना जाता है-
questions.questionTextEn: When two or more users are waiting for data locked by each other, such situations are known as?
questions.explanation: A Deadlock occurs when two or more transactions are each waiting for the other to release a lock, creating a circular dependency. Transaction A waits for B's lock; B waits for A's lock → neither can proceed → deadlock.

questions.questionText: सर्वर प्रक्रिया जो लॉक मैनेजर कार्यक्षमता को लागू करती है, कहलाती है?
questions.questionTextEn: The server process that implements lock manager functionality is called?
questions.explanation: The Lock Manager Process implements all locking functionality: granting lock requests, tracking existing locks, detecting deadlocks, and releasing locks. It maintains the lock table and manages all concurrency control through locking.

questions.questionText: फ्रंट-एंड पर सर्वर सिस्टम आर्किटेक्चर है-
questions.questionTextEn: The server system architecture at the front-end has?
questions.explanation: The front-end server system architecture includes ALL user-facing components: (1) Data mining and analysis tools, (2) SQL user interfaces (query tools), (3) Report generating tools. Back-end has the SQL Engine.

questions.questionText: कॉलम में मानों की संख्या जात करने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किस कीवर्ड का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following keywords is used to find out the number of values in a column?
questions.explanation: COUNT() is the SQL aggregate function that returns the number of values/rows in a column. Example: SELECT COUNT(salary) FROM emp; — returns the number of non-null salary values. SUM() adds values; COUNT() counts them.

questions.questionText: लॉग रिकॉर्ड्स बफर में लॉग रिकॉर्ड्स जोड़ना किसका काम है?
questions.questionTextEn: Adding log records to the log records buffer is the job of?
questions.explanation: Server Processes (user processes' server counterparts) are responsible for generating and adding log records to the redo log buffer in memory. The Log Writer process then writes these buffered log records to the redo log files on disk.

questions.questionText: एप्लिकेशन क्लाइंटमशीन पर रहता है और क्वेरी स्टेटमेंट के माध्यम से सर्वर मशीन पर डेटाबेस सिस्टम की कार्यक्षमता को आमंत्रित करता है, किस प्रकार को जाना जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Application resides at the client machine and invokes database system functionality at the server machine through query statements — this is what type of architecture?
questions.explanation: Two-tier architecture: Client application (Tier 1) directly communicates with the Database Server (Tier 2) using SQL/query statements. No middle application server layer exists. The client has both UI and business logic.

questions.questionText: Credentials को सत्यापित करने और डेटाबेस तक पहुँच की अनुमति देने की प्रक्रिया को _______ कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The process of verifying credentials and allowing access to the database is called its?
questions.explanation: Database Authentication is the process of verifying the identity (credentials — username/password, certificates, tokens) of a user or application before granting access to the database.

questions.questionText: विशेषता मानों के एक अनियंत्रित सेट को किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: An unordered set of attribute values is named as?
questions.explanation: In the relational model, a Tuple is an unordered set of attribute values — it represents a single row/record in a relation (table). Tuples are unordered within the relation, and attribute values within a tuple are accessed by attribute name, not position.

questions.questionText: निगरानी और मूल्यांकन प्रदान करना किसकी जिम्मेदारी है?
questions.questionTextEn: Providing monitoring and evaluation is the responsibility of?
questions.explanation: Database Security includes monitoring database activities (audit trails, access logs) and evaluating security compliance. Monitoring who accessed what, when, and detecting suspicious activities are key security responsibilities.

questions.questionText: एक ही आउटपुट वैल्यू के लिए कई इनपुट वैल्यू को हेशिंग करने वाला शब्द है-
questions.questionTextEn: The term that refers to hashing multiple input values to the same output value is?
questions.explanation: A Hash Collision occurs when two or more different input values produce the same hash output value. This is an inherent limitation of hash functions since they map infinite inputs to finite outputs. Collision handling is important in hash-based indexing.

questions.questionText: लॉग-इन के लिए एक कंप्यूटर सुरक्षा को सूचना प्रणाली के _______ घटक के उदाहरण के रूप में माना जा सकता है।
questions.questionTextEn: A computer security mechanism for logging-in can be considered as the example of the ______ component of an information system.
questions.explanation: Login security is a Procedure — a set of steps/rules (enter username, enter password, verify credentials, grant/deny access). Procedures are the policies and methods for using, operating, securing, and maintaining the information system.

questions.questionText: एक गैर-प्रक्रियात्मक भाषा का नाम ______ होना चाहिए?
questions.questionTextEn: A non-procedural language is named to be?
questions.explanation: A Non-procedural language is called a Declarative language — you DECLARE what you want (the result) without specifying HOW to get it (the procedure). SQL is the prime example. You declare the desired result; the DB engine determines the execution plan.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस टेबल और व्यू के रीड ओनली संग्रह को ________ के माध्यम से एक्सेस किया जा सकता है?
questions.questionTextEn: A read-only collection of database tables and views can be accessed through?
questions.explanation: The Data Dictionary (System Catalog) contains a read-only collection of database metadata tables and views. Users can query the data dictionary views (like Oracle's USER_TABLES, ALL_COLUMNS) to get information about database objects, but cannot directly modify them.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस के लिए डेटा ब्लॉक का आकार यदि इसके दीरान तय किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The size for a data block for a database is fixed during its?
questions.explanation: The database block size (DB_BLOCK_SIZE parameter) is set during database CREATION and cannot be changed afterwards without recreating the database. This is a fundamental database parameter that determines the smallest unit of I/O.
